ambient_events: The fountains drop for a second, then come back up.
Somebody sits on the edge of the basin and eats a hot dog over the water.
A groundskeeper picks ticket stubs out of a hedge one at a time.
description: Hughson Gardens, the west fountain: an octagonal limestone basin, two tiers and a gilt sun on top, with jets arching in from the rim. Yews in stone planters stand at the corners. On game nights the basin fills up with ticket stubs.
name: Hughson Gardens
